related.title: AI-Guided Surveillance and Curative Salvage of Recurrence After Hepatocellular Carcinoma Resection or Ablation
related.briefSummary: Hepatocellular carcinoma, the most common type of primary liver cancer, can recur after liver resection or thermal ablation performed with curative intent. Follow-up imaging is commonly scheduled at fixed intervals, although the risk of recurrence differs among patients and may change over time. This study will test whether a locked artificial intelligence system can use routinely collected clinical, laboratory, and imaging information to recommend when the next surveillance scan should occur.
